title: MAXIFE: Multilingual and Cross-lingual Instruction Following Evaluation
reasoning: The benchmark evaluates the instruction-following capabilities of LLMs across 23 languages using objective categories such as keywords, length, format, and tone. It does not contain an evaluation component for religion, faith, morals, or ethics. The authors explicitly state that they filtered out metadata involving safety, ethics, or other sensitive issues during the dataset construction phase to focus on instruction adherence.
